notes.title: Vote for Horizon Shift for TIGA's Game Of The Year.
notes.content:
Voting for the TIGA game of the year award is open and Horizon Shift is on the list!!!

If you liked the game why not drop a vote Horizon Shift's way :)

http://awards.tiga.org/awards_vote.php

It's in order of Studio, so it's under Flump Studios - Horizon Shift

Thanks everyone :)
